text: ok. these are alright. next so in the mesh editor, i save something as a wall or a floor, and it doesnt show up in the walls or floors so its lying. fix it. i have walls and floors ive made that should show up in these categories and they are in the props
resolution: Cooking a Studio model AS a wall/floor was lying: it showed only under props, never the wall/floor tab. Root cause: the dialog records buildPlacement.pieceKind and the SWAP picker (cookedCatalogPickEntries) honored it, but the build browser tabs read catalogEntriesByKind, which filtered cooked entries by their raw kind — and every cooked asset is kind:'prop' (the shared mesh substrate). Fix: catalogEntriesByKind now routes a cooked entry by its declared FAMILY when that family owns a browser tab (wall/floor/ramp/roof/stairs/elevator/pillar) — so it lists under that tab and drops out of props — falling back to 'prop' for no-tab families (railing/fence/trim) so nothing is ever hidden. Factored the family resolution (cookedEntryFamily) shared with the swap picker; built-in props untouched. Verified with 2 new regression tests in cookedPiece.test.ts (cooked wall→wall tab & not props; cooked floor→floor; railing stays in props): all 11 pass. TSX/TS, hot-reloads in rjit dev — existing cooked walls/floors you saved will now appear in those tabs.
